items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Papa Celestan, I worked with him in later years.

ctx.x: I was going to ask about the early parades, the ones that if you remember what the bands were like.

Well in the parades, well I remember, well I know, I tell you one thing, the favorite one, one of the main favorites of the kids was Lewis Armstrong. Because all they had to say, oh yes, here come Lewis Armstrong and all the kids just tear out the house. Oh yes, everybody used to tear, you know, you know second line of the halls, I know you know about that. Oh yeah, I remember that. And gosh, and they were loaded I think. But I mean, the music always did touch me, no kidding, I mean, I just like it and always,…
Can you tell more about his style? Because John said Buddy Pt, that you play like him sometimes, you play a little chorus and
